name: The Exquisite Night Chimes
description:
Chantons, là où s'étend la brume.
Dansons, là où le vent emporte le sable.
Les vieilles chansons disparaissent dans le pays des souvenirs et des rêves,
et ce n'est que dans les légendes,
que l'eau claire des rivières s'écoule à travers l'éternelle verdure.

otherAdditions: A brand-new Battle Pass-exclusive Furnishing Blueprint as compensation to Travelers who have unlocked Version 3.3's Gnostic Chorus.
Adds some prompts for loading screens.
Added Sets 15–20 of "Paimon's Paintings" chat emojis.
New casual PvP "Heated Battle Mode" in Genius Invokation TCG that skips Roll Phase and go straight to getting 8 Omni Element Dice
Add Match History function to Genius Invokation TCG.
New invitation duels and guest challenges added to the Player List.
Adds markers for Teleport Waypoints and Domains in non-outdoor areas on the map.
The gadget "Launch Tube" and other fireworks can now be purchased from the NPC Granny Shan in Liyue Harbor.
Consecrated Scorpions and Scorpions are added to the area around the Serpent's Head in Yashiori Island.
Tree of Dreams, Vanarana: Increase in the Level Cap of Tree of Dreams to Level 40.
